# Daniekeys Studios

> Daniekeys Studios is an AI-powered, remote-first creative and growth studio from Nigeria. We help startups and growing businesses in Nigeria, the UAE, the UK and worldwide get more customers through brand identity, video editing and motion, graphic design and flyers, websites, UI/UX design and social media management, all planned around a clear marketing and sales strategy.

Standard turnaround: 48 to 72 hours. Every project starts with a Growth Diagnosis: who buys, why they should pick you, what's stopping them, and a one-page marketing plan.

## Services and starting prices (naira / US dollars)

- Growth Diagnosis: from ₦50,000 / $100, credited to the project
- Brand Foundations (strategy, logo, colour, type, guidelines): from ₦350,000 / $800
- Brand 360 (identity, website, launch film, five launch posts): from ₦1,200,000 / $2,500
- Launch Page: from ₦200,000 / $450
- Marketing Site: from ₦450,000 / $1,200
- UI/UX Design (app and dashboard screens, prototypes): from ₦400,000 / $900
- Video Editing (reels, ads, YouTube, event recaps): from ₦50,000 / $100
- Logo Animation: from ₦60,000 / $120
- Motion Ads and AI video ads: from ₦150,000 / $350
- Launch Film: from ₦350,000 / $900
- Flyers and Graphics: from ₦20,000 / $50 each
- Social Media Management: from ₦200,000 / $500 a month
